propositions: Completion verification fails verdict-less when primary run exhausts budget or loops despite banked criterion verdicts, requiring recovery redesign to finalize full-coverage verdicts from partial progress.

Recovery architecture fans out one isolated LLM run per criterion (worst case 22 criteria × 20-request budget = 440 requests), causing request and context explosion when ticket context grows beyond flat 100K-char bound.
Duplicate read-only tool calls repeat without memoization during agentic runs, causing runaway loops (observed 144× identical search_files calls in single run).

Context ceilings must bound re-send spend and model window exhaustion while preserving d59e invariants (no billable calls on refusal; ticket c9f7 at 121,147 chars currently refused by flat 100K-char bound).

Verifier context pre-loading can reduce agentic read round-trips by caching ranked file_impact contents with full/skeleton manifest, with live traces showing 67-82% of distinct file reads covered by subtree file_impact.
